prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1145; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was southbound on a residential road in League City, Texas, when the vehicle made contact head-on with a northbound vehicle operated by Driver 2 at low speed. Both drivers stopped at the scene and remained with their vehicles. Driver 1 reported a concussion and complained of headache and dizziness; the injury is consistent with the forces involved in a frontal impact of this kind. Driver 2 confirmed the sequence of events as described by Driver 1, and two independent witnesses gave statements that match that account. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the front of both vehicles that corresponds to the reported point and direction of impact. Officers observed no prior damage to either vehicle that would suggest an earlier incident. A Passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and both the witnesses and officers confirmed this. Driver 1 is listed as an insured driver on the policy covering the vehicle. Both parties were transported or released according to their condition, and no citations were issued at the scene.
